caseName: Collie v. S.C. Comm'n On Lawyer Conduct
caseNameFull: Cynthia E. COLLIE v. SOUTH CAROLINA COMMISSION ON LAWYER CONDUCT.

opinions.text: Motion of petitioner for leave to proceed in forma pauperis denied. Petitioner allowed until June 30, 2014, within which to pay the docketing fee required by Rule *274638(a) and to submit a petition in compliance with Rule 33.1 of the Rules of this Court.
